annadanam.payment_method: Online Payment Gateway / Direct Bank Transfer to Executive Officer, Sri Sammakka Saralamma Devasthanam Account / Official Canara Bank QR Code Scanner at Temple Premises

e_hundi.payment_method: Digital Hundi via Official Canara Bank QR Code Scanners deployed across Gaddelu premises and online payment portal

refund_policy: Donations made towards Annadanam, E-Hundi, or Temple Development Corpus are non-refundable once successfully processed.

In the event of duplicate transactions caused by network glitches, donors can submit proof of double deduction (Bank Statement & Transaction Ref ID) to the Executive Officer Desk (collector.mulugu@gmail.com) for manual reconciliation.
